nodes.name: Eber, the Plaguemaw
nodes.summary: Boss of the Pale Council encounter in The Pale Court (Prophecy system). Introduced in 2.3.0; the wiki marks the Pale Council fight as removed from the game in 3.17.0.

sources.locator: Infobox: location = The Pale Court; header 'The prophecy system was removed ... in version 3.17.0. The Pale Council fight no longer exists'; Version history 2.3.0 'Introduced to the game'

nodes.name: Inya, the Unbearable Whispers
nodes.summary: Boss of the Pale Council encounter in The Pale Court (Prophecy system). Introduced in 2.3.0 and removed in 3.17.0 per the wiki; in 3.0.0 the Pale Council was rebalanced and Inya became a drop source for Inya's Epiphany.

sources.locator: Infobox: location = The Pale Court; Drops: 'guaranteed to drop Inya's Epiphany ... if she was the last one to be killed ... the sequence ... is random'; Version history 3.17.0 'Removed from the game'

nodes.name: Yriel, the Feral Lord
nodes.summary: Boss of The Pale Court or the 'The Feral Lord V' Prophecy encounter (Pale Council). Known for Blast Rain, Decoy Shot and beast-summoning traps; removed in 3.17.0 per the wiki.

sources.locator: Intro: 'a boss in The Pale Court or The Feral Lord V encounters'; Abilities list; Version history 3.17.0 'Removed from the game'

nodes.name: Volkuur, the Unbreathing Queen
nodes.summary: Boss of The Pale Court (Pale Council, Prophecy system); the wiki states the Pale Council fight no longer exists after 3.17.0. Drops Volkuur's Guidance.

sources.locator: Header: 'The prophecy system was removed from the game in version 3.17.0. The Pale Council fight no longer exists'; infobox location = The Pale Court; Drops: 'drops Volkuur's Guidance'

nodes.name: The Pale Council
nodes.summary: Group of four Pale Court bosses (Yriel, Eber, Volkuur and Inya) fought through the Prophecy system; the wiki says the Pale Council fight no longer exists after 3.17.0. In the wiki's in-world history the Pale Council were rulers of an unidentified people, likely the Karui.

sources.locator: section 'The Pale Council': '[[The Pale Council]] is a group comprising of Yriel, the Feral Lord, Eber, the Plaguemaw, Volkuur, and Inya'
Drops: 'sequence of last alive member of the Pale Council is random'; Version history 3.0.0 'The Pale Council encounter has been rebalanced'
Header: 'The Pale Council fight no longer exists in Path of Exile'

nodes.name: The Pale Court
nodes.summary: Prophecy-system area where the Pale Council bosses (Eber, Inya, Yriel, Volkuur) are fought; the wiki states this content was removed in 3.17.0.

sources.locator: Infobox location = [[The Pale Court]]; header 'The prophecy system was removed from the game in version 3.17.0'

nodes.name: Zorath, Vile Assembled
nodes.summary: Endgame pinnacle boss of the Abyss mechanic. Its arena, The Lightless Hollow, is reached directly on the Atlas; the fight begins once four Zorath's Eye fragments are placed in its head. New content in 3.29.0 per the wiki.

sources.locator: Intro: 'the endgame pinnacle boss of the Abyss mechanic'; header 'New content version=3.29.0'; Entry: 'Players must place four different Zorath's Eye fragments into Zorath's head'

nodes.name: The Lightless Hollow
nodes.summary: Circular arena with a central abyssal pit where Zorath lies suspended; accessible directly on the Atlas.

sources.locator: Entry: "Zorath's arena is called The Lightless Hollow, and can be directly traversed to on the Atlas"

nodes.name: Abaxoth, the End of All That Is
nodes.summary: Unique Beyond demon, seen dual-wielding two Edges of Madness, with Berserk Fury and a Chaos damage-over-time aura. The wiki states that 3.19.0 replaced the original Beyond demons with Scourge monsters and removed Abaxoth.

sources.locator: Intro: 'is a unique Beyond Demon'; header '3.19.0 replaced the original Beyond demons with monsters from Scourge'; Version history 1.2.0 'Introduced' / 3.19.0 'Removed from the game'

nodes.name: Kole
nodes.summary: Unique demon monster in The Lunaris Temple Level 1 (Act 3), with a high-damage Ground Smash and a chain pull. Per the wiki's lore section (attributed to Grigor), Kole was an Oriathan rapist whom Piety used in her experiments. A stronger Carnage variant appeared in the Tower Map (2.4.0-3.1.0).

chronology.relative: Act 3 (c. Piety's experiments; relative date unknown)

sources.locator: Infobox: location = The Lunaris Temple Level 1 (Act 3); Lore: 'According to Grigor, Kole was an Oriathan ... before Piety used him in her experiments'

nodes.name: Meginord
nodes.summary: Figure referred to only in flavour text and names of unique belts (e.g. Meginord's Girdle, Meginord's Vise). The wiki says he ruled a northern part of Wraeclast, but it is unclear whether he is a person or a naming pun.

sources.locator: Intro: 'a figure only mentioned in the flavour text and names of unique items'; Lore: 'it is unclear whether the character was intended to be called north-north'

nodes.name: Lethal Pride
nodes.summary: Unique Timeless Jewel of the Karui variant. Conquers passives in radius with Karui leadership over warriors under Akoya, Kaom or Rakiata (seed-dependent); adds Strength to small passives. Drops from the Karui legion general in the Domain of Timeless Conflict.

sources.locator: Infobox: base_item = Timeless Jewel; explicit1_text 'Commanded leadership over (10000-18000) warriors under <Akoya • Kaom • Rakiata>'; drop_text 'Karui legion in the Domain of Timeless Conflict'

nodes.name: Brutal Restraint
nodes.summary: Unique Timeless Jewel of the Maraketh variant. Conquers passives in radius with service of dekhara in the akhara of Asenath, Balbala or Nasima; transforms keystones into exclusive ones. Drops from the Maraketh legion general in the Domain of Timeless Conflict.

sources.locator: Infobox: explicit1_text 'Denoted service of (500-8000) dekhara in the akhara of <Asenath • Balbala • Nasima>'; drop_text 'Maraketh legion in the Domain of Timeless Conflict'

nodes.name: Militant Faith
nodes.summary: Unique Timeless Jewel of the Templar variant. Conquers passives in radius with new faithful converted by High Templar Avarius, Dominus or Maxarius; adds Devotion to small and notable passives. Drops from the Templar legion general in the Domain of Timeless Conflict.

sources.locator: Infobox: explicit1_text 'Carved to glorify (2000-10000) new faithful converted by High Templar <Avarius • Dominus • Maxarius>'; drop_text 'Templar legion in the Domain of Timeless Conflict'

nodes.name: Nasima
nodes.summary: Listed among the Maraketh's notable members (the list gives the name without a Sekhema title); one of the three akhara named on the Brutal Restraint Timeless Jewel. The corpus holds only list-level mentions, so details are limited.

sources.locator: Notable members list: '* [[Nasima]]' under the Maraketh section
Variant table: 'Nasima' with 'Denoted service of # dekhara in the akhara of Nasima'

nodes.name: Into the Breach
nodes.summary: Act 6 tutorial quest for the Breach mechanic. Ailith's flame burns the Hiveborn barrier at the Mud Flats entrance; the Exile then bonds the Genesis Tree at the Monastery of the Keepers. Introduced in 3.27.0; the 3.28.0 Keepers rework replaced the original Breach mechanic.

sources.locator: Quest info: 'Into the Breach is the a tutorial quest for Breach'; Walkthrough 'Burn away the barrier the Hiveborn built'; Walkthrough 'Allocate a Womb on the Genesis Tree'; Version history 3.28.0 'replaced the original Breech mechanic' and 3.27.0 'Introduced to the game'

nodes.name: Into The Nexus
nodes.summary: Act 1 quest exclusive to the Synthesis league: Cavas has the Exile connect collected memories to the Memory Nexus and explore them. Quest removed in 3.7.0.

sources.locator: Quest info: start 'Talk to Cavas', completion 'You have explored the connected memories'; Version history 3.6.0 'Introduced', 3.7.0 'Removed from the game'

nodes.name: The Mud Flats (Act 6)
nodes.summary: Act 6 area reached from the Coast; its entrance is blocked by Hiveborn structures until the Into the Breach quest is started.

sources.locator: Walkthrough: 'approaching the entrance to the Mud Flats from the Coast in Act 6, where the entrance is blocked off by Hiveborn structures'

nodes.name: Exploring Kingsmarch
nodes.summary: Tutorial quest for Kingsmarch. Johan in Karui Shores sends the Exile into Kingsmarch, where Raulf explains recruitment and Johan handles placement and finances.

sources.locator: Quest infobox: start 'Arrive in the Karui Shores in the Epilogue', objective 'Learn about Kingsmarch', completion 'Speak to Johan'; Walkthrough: 'Introduce yourself to Raulf, hire a recruit, and then return to me'

nodes.name: Lighting the Way
nodes.summary: Act 7 quest: the Exile gathers seven Fireflies in the Dread Thicket and delivers them to Yeena, who brews Fire Dew to burn open the entrance to Arakaali's temple.

sources.locator: Quest infobox: start 'Take the first Firefly in the Dread Thicket', completion 'Talk to Yeena'; Walkthrough: 'Yeena needs seven Fireflies to burn open the entrance to Arakaali's temple'

nodes.name: Toward the Future
nodes.summary: Act 10 quest closing the campaign: after defeating Kitava, Lilly Roth in Oriath Docks offers to sail the Exile away; completing it is 'Set Sail from Oriath'.

sources.locator: Quest infobox: act 10, start 'Talk to Lilly Roth in Oriath Docks', completion 'Set Sail from Oriath'; Walkthrough: 'Talk to Lilly Roth after defeating Kitava'

nodes.name: Maiden Voyage
nodes.summary: Act 1 tutorial for the Curse of the Allflame league: Valerie the Corsair invites the Exile aboard the Sovereign as First Mate, after the Coast waypoint starts the quest.

sources.locator: Quest infobox: act 1, objective 'Explore the depths of the ocean'; 'a tutorial quest for Curse of the Allflame'; Walkthrough: 'Valerie has asked you to be her First Mate'

nodes.name: Turning the Tide
nodes.summary: Endgame Curse of the Allflame quest required to unlock Velka, the Tide Witch: Vesper imbues the Exile with the Allflame to pass Velka's barrier, then the Exile defeats Velka and retrieves her Allflame.

sources.locator: Quest infobox: start 'Explore a Kishara's Rest chart', objective 'Defeat Velka and retrieve her Allflame', act 'Epilogue'; Walkthrough: 'Allow me to imbue you with the power of the Allflame'

nodes.name: Cutting Off the Supply
nodes.summary: Betrayal-league Act 1 quest: Jun asks the Exile to help intercept an Immortal Syndicate transport in the Mud Flats. Quest removed in 3.6.0.

sources.locator: Header: 'was a quest in Act 1 exclusive to the Betrayal league'; Version history 3.6.0 'Removed from the game'

nodes.name: Breaking Down the Door
nodes.summary: Betrayal-league Act 1 quest: Jun asks the Exile to help dismantle Immortal Syndicate fortifications on the Coast. After the league it was replaced by the Immortal Syndicate quest.

sources.locator: Header: 'was a quest in Act 1 exclusive to the Betrayal league. After the league end it is replaced by The Immortal Syndicate'; Walkthrough: 'Jun wants you to help her find and dismantle the Immortal Syndicate fortifications on the Coast'

nodes.name: Dying for a Fight
nodes.summary: Optional tutorial for the Trial of the Ancestors: after finding a Silver Coin, the Exile rubs it in town to open a portal to the Halls of the Dead, where Navali sets the trial.

sources.locator: Quest infobox: start 'Find a Silver Coin', objective 'Challenge the Ancestors'; Walkthrough: 'Rub it between your fingers in a Town or Hideout to open a portal to the Halls of the Dead'

nodes.name: The Rogue Harbour (quest)
nodes.summary: Act 6 introductory quest for the Heist mechanic: after Kurai and a Rogue's Marker, the Exile opens a portal to The Rogue Harbour, takes Contract: Trial Run from Kurai and finishes it with Karst.

sources.locator: Quest infobox: act 6, required no, start 'Lioneye's Watch (Act 6)', completion 'Talk to Kurai after finishing the contract'; Version history 3.12.0 'Introduced to the game'

nodes.name: Mines (Delve)
nodes.summary: Biome of the Azurite Mine (Delve) that generates only at the top levels of the mine; contains Metallic, Serrated, Pristine and Aetheric fossils. Introduced in 3.4.0.

sources.locator: Intro: 'Mines is one of the biomes of the Azurite Mine. It only generates at the very top levels of the mine'; Version history 3.4.0 'Introduced to the game'

nodes.name: Sulphur Vents (Delve)
nodes.summary: Biome of the Azurite Mine (Delve) with Fractured, Metallic, Perfect, Aetheric and Encrusted fossils; its biome-specific nodes include Humid Fissure and Restless Rubble. Introduced in 3.4.0.

sources.locator: Intro: 'Sulfur Vents is one of the biomes of the Azurite Mine'; Fossils list; Version history 3.4.0 'Introduced to the game'

nodes.name: The Lich's Tomb
nodes.summary: Delve node of the Azurite Mine, found in the Abyssal City biome at depth 90+; it always contains the boss fight with Kurgal, the Blackblooded in the Abyssal Sanctum. The boss room is no longer accessible in a new instance after the kill.

sources.locator: Intro: 'It can only appeared in 90+ depths in the Abyssal City biome ... it always contains the boss fight with Kurgal, the Blackblooded'; 'After the boss fight has been finished, the node can be revisited'

nodes.name: Abyssal Depths (Delve)
nodes.summary: Biome of the Azurite Mine (Delve) that uses Abyss theme and contains Abyss monsters. It is distinct from the Abyssal City biome (which spawns The Lich's Tomb) and from the Abyssal Depths map area (existing node loc_abyssal_depths).

sources.locator: Intro: 'Abyssal Depths is a biome within the Azurite Mine'; hatnote: 'For the area accessible from completing an Abyss encounter in map'; Version history 3.4.0 'Introduced to the game.'
